scope: Verified game-specific native ports, decompilation-based ports, static recompilations, and reimplementations from one console family to another. Excludes emulators and projects whose documented source is PC-only. Hardware/playability claims are limited to maintainer documentation.

projects.title: Animal Crossing Dreamcast Port
projects.status: The maintainer reports real-hardware boot and town exploration; the project is not yet a playable game.
projects.summary: Native Dreamcast port built from recovered Animal Crossing source, with a Dreamcast graphics backend.

projects.title: Animal Crossing 3DS Port
projects.status: Early release; project reports around 60 FPS in most town scenes on New 3DS. Original 3DS is untested.
projects.summary: Native port built from the Animal Crossing decompilation, with GameCube graphics calls adapted to PICA200.

projects.title: Animal Crossing Original Xbox Port
projects.status: Version 1 is reported fully playable at 60 FPS on a stock 64 MB Xbox; requires US Rev 0 game data.
projects.summary: Native Xbox port that compiles decompiled C for the Xbox Pentium III and GPU.

projects.title: Animal Crossing Vita Port
projects.status: Alpha port boots and is playable; the README notes frame-rate dips during rain and ocean scenes.
projects.summary: Native Vita port built from Animal Crossing decompilation source.

projects.title: Banjo-Kazooie Wii U Port
projects.status: Final v1.6 release; README notes occasional long-session crashes, rare HOME-menu hangs, and a missing intro model.
projects.summary: Wii U target for the Lighthouse decompilation-based Banjo-Kazooie port.

projects.title: Bird & Beans / Pyoro Wii Port
projects.status: Native Wii homebrew port with both games and controller support documented; requires user-provided DSiWare game data.
projects.summary: Wii implementation of the DS/DSiWare games using native code and assets supplied by the user; the maintainer does not describe it as a decompilation or recompilation.

projects.title: Crash Team Racing PS4 Port
projects.status: Version 0.1.2; maintainer reports PS4 Pro testing with graphics, audio, controller, and memory-card saves.
projects.summary: Native PS4 port based on the CTR Turbocharged decompilation.

projects.title: Dark Cloud PS4 Port
projects.status: Version 0.1.0 PKG; maintainer reports testing on PS4 firmware 13.52 at 1080p/60 FPS.
projects.summary: Native PS4 port based on the Chronicle decompilation; not an emulator.

projects.title: Diddy Kong Racing Dreamcast Port
projects.status: Dreamcast target is documented; the decompilation and Adventure mode remain incomplete, and Dreamcast execution is not confirmed.
projects.summary: A decompilation-based Dreamcast port in progress. The README reports partial Adventure progress and does not claim a playable Dreamcast build.

projects.title: Diddy Kong Racing Vita Port
projects.status: Release loads game data, renders races and menus, and supports saves/audio; full Adventure completion is not confirmed.
projects.summary: Native Vita port based on Diddy Kong Racing decompilation code.

projects.title: Digimon World 3 Switch Port
projects.status: Homebrew port based on the ReGame-Labs decompilation; consult the maintainer README for current maturity.
projects.summary: Nintendo Switch port using recovered PlayStation game code.

projects.title: Donkey Kong Country 2 Switch Recompilation
projects.game: Donkey Kong Country 2: Diddy’s Kong Quest
projects.platform: Super Nintendo Entertainment System → Nintendo Switch
projects.status: Static recompilation boots and executes on real Switch hardware; widescreen remains under validation.
projects.summary: Native Switch build produced from a static recompilation of the SNES game.

projects.title: Doom 64 PS3 Port
projects.status: Version 1.0 release; maintainer reports real-hardware testing. Full-game completion is not claimed.
projects.summary: PS3 native port derived from the Dreamcast port and ultimately the Doom 64 reverse-engineered project; requires user-owned game data.

projects.title: F-Zero SNES Switch Port
projects.platform: Super Nintendo Entertainment System → Nintendo Switch
projects.status: Nintendo Switch port of a Super Nintendo recompilation.
projects.summary: Native Switch build based on the SNES F-Zero recompilation project.

projects.title: F-Zero X 3DS Port
projects.status: Playable; project reports a median 59.6 FPS on tested hardware, with heavy expansion packs causing slowdowns.
projects.summary: Native port using the F-Zero X decompilation and G-Diffuser components.

projects.title: F-Zero X Switch Port
projects.status: Version 1.0.1; requires user-provided ROM, 64DD data, and BIOS.
projects.summary: Switch build of F-Zero X using G-Diffuser components and the matching decompilation.

projects.title: Forsaken 3DS Port
projects.status: Project reports the solo campaign playable and generally stable at 60 FPS on old and New 3DS.
projects.summary: Native 3DS port based on ForsakenX; source versions include multiple original platforms.

projects.title: GoldenEye 007 3DS Port
projects.status: Bring-up stage; the README reports the Dam level working, not a finished port.
projects.summary: Nintendo 3DS target for GoldenEye 007 decompilation source.

projects.title: GoldenEye 007 Vita Port
projects.status: Project reports all 20 single-player missions completed through credits on Vita hardware.
projects.summary: Native Vita port built from GoldenEye 007 decompilation source.

projects.title: Halo: Combat Evolved Switch Port
projects.status: Native Switch build from the original Xbox build 2342; README documents campaign, saves, checkpoints, and cinematics, with some video features skipped.
projects.summary: Switch port of the Xbox decompilation with D3D8 calls translated to deko3d. Requires user-owned game data.

projects.title: Halo: Combat Evolved Vita Port
projects.status: Vita port based on the original Xbox build 2342 decompilation; verify the latest project README for supported game data and remaining limits.
projects.summary: Native Vita port of the original Xbox release built from decompiled source.

projects.title: Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days Vita Port
projects.status: Native Vita port; DS display, sound, card, and touch behavior are reimplemented. README specifies the supported European cartridge.
projects.summary: Port of the DS decompilation to Vita with a native platform layer.

projects.title: Mario Kart 64 Dreamcast Port
projects.status: README documents physical-hardware testing, VMU saves, and ghost data.
projects.summary: Native Dreamcast port built from the N64 decompilation with Dreamcast graphics and audio layers.

projects.title: Mario Kart 64 3DS Port
projects.status: Experimental release; solo versus and battle modes are reported, with compatibility work ongoing.
projects.summary: 3DS port of the SpaghettiKart native reimplementation.

projects.title: Mario Kart 64 Original Xbox Port
projects.status: README reports around 30 FPS on real Xbox hardware; requires the user's supported US game image.
projects.summary: Native Xbox port based on N64 decompilation code and the Dreamcast port.

projects.title: Mario Kart 64 PSP Port
projects.status: README reports 60 FPS single-player and 30 FPS Ad Hoc multiplayer, with cups and courses playable; requires the supported US ROM.
projects.summary: Native PSP port of decompiled N64 C code with PSP graphics and audio layers.

projects.title: Mario Kart Wii 3DS Port
projects.status: Version 0.5.2; Grand Prix, time trials, and Battle work. Coin Runners and Team VS remain unfinished.
projects.summary: Native reimplementation and 3DS port, not a Wii emulator.

projects.title: Mass Effect Switch Recompilation
projects.status: Work in progress with several early game areas and systems reported playable; frame rate varies by scene.
projects.summary: Nintendo Switch port built using static PowerPC recompilation and Vulkan/NVK.

projects.title: Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks Switch Recompilation
projects.status: Static recompilation project for Switch using Vulkan; see the project README for current compatibility.
projects.summary: Nintendo Switch build based on Xbox executable recompilation.

projects.title: Mushihimesama Futari Switch Recompilation
projects.status: Static recompilation supports the specified disc image; README does not quantify gameplay readiness.
projects.summary: Switch build recompiles Xbox 360 executable code and uses native Vulkan rendering.

projects.title: Need for Speed: Carbon Switch Port
projects.status: Native Switch NRO build based on static Xbox recompilation; maturity and compatibility details should be checked in the project README.
projects.summary: Port of the original Xbox release to Switch using static recompilation.

projects.title: Need for Speed: Most Wanted Switch Recompilation
projects.status: Static PPC recompilation; project reports an approximately 30 FPS target with heavier scenes dipping below it.
projects.summary: Switch port based on a static recompilation of the Xbox 360 release, using Vulkan/NVK.

projects.title: Need for Speed: Underground 2 Switch Port
projects.status: Native Switch NRO build based on static Xbox recompilation; maturity and compatibility details should be checked in the project README.
projects.summary: Port of the original Xbox release to Switch using static recompilation.

projects.title: Paper Mario 3DS Port
projects.status: Native 3DS CIA/3DSX builds; New 3DS performance is reported around 60 FPS, with lower rates on older hardware.
projects.summary: Native 3DS port based on the Paper Mario decompilation.

projects.title: Perfect Dark Switch Port
projects.status: Work in progress; an ARM64 Switch build target is documented.
projects.summary: Native Switch build based on Perfect Dark decompilation source.

projects.title: Pokémon Emerald Rogue EX Vita Port
projects.status: Maintainer reports 60 FPS on PS Vita 1000; the project requires the matching user-owned game image.
projects.summary: Native ARM port of the C game to PS Vita; it does not emulate Game Boy Advance hardware.

projects.title: Pokémon Platinum PSP Port
projects.status: Beta native PSP port; project marks the supported US revision playable around 30 FPS, with feature and hardware limits.
projects.summary: Native PSP EBOOT built from community decompilation C source; not a DS emulator.

projects.title: Pokémon SoulSilver PSP Port
projects.status: Beta native PSP port; project marks the supported US SoulSilver revision playable around 30 FPS, with feature and hardware limits.
projects.summary: Native PSP EBOOT built from community decompilation C source; not a DS emulator.

projects.title: Resident Evil 4 Dreamcast Port
projects.status: Experimental port; a console test reached the end of Chapter 2 part 1, with crashes, visual gaps, and performance work remaining.
projects.summary: Experimental Dreamcast port based on recovered GameCube code with platform-specific graphics, audio, disc, and memory-card layers.

projects.title: Resident Evil Code: Veronica X Vita Port
projects.status: Early port reaches title and gameplay; models, text, FMVs, and performance remain incomplete.
projects.summary: Converts decompiled PlayStation 2 code into C and replaces system services for a native Vita target.

projects.title: Silent Hill PS3 Port
projects.status: PS3 target is in development; a semi-functional build is reported but not a finished release.
projects.summary: Native PS3 target in the Silent Hill decompilation port project; other platform targets have separate maturity levels.

projects.title: Sonic Advance 2 Dreamcast Port
projects.status: Dreamcast port target is present; matching work is incomplete and a finished Dreamcast build is not established.
projects.summary: Decompilation-based Dreamcast port effort with ongoing function matching and incomplete game code.

projects.title: Sonic Advance 2 Switch Port
projects.status: Early version; the main stage works, while visual issues, cutscenes, multiplayer, and Tiny Chao remain incomplete.
projects.summary: Native Switch build based on Sonic Advance 2 decompilation code.

projects.title: Sonic Advance 2 PS2 and PSP Port
projects.platform: Game Boy Advance → PlayStation 2, PlayStation Portable
projects.status: WIP; project documents PS2 ISO and PSP EBOOT builds but does not establish gameplay on either target.
projects.summary: Multi-target native port effort based on Sonic Advance 2 decompilation code; function matching is incomplete.

projects.title: Star Fox 64 Dreamcast Port
projects.status: Dreamcast port with project-linked real-hardware footage.
projects.summary: Native Dreamcast port based on the Star Fox 64 decompilation, with VMU save and rumble support described by the project.

projects.title: Star Fox 64 PSP Port
projects.status: Work in progress; the README documents a PSP build target but does not report gameplay status.
projects.summary: PSP target for Star Fox 64 decompilation code.

projects.title: Streets of Rage Dreamcast Port
projects.status: Static translation project documents gameplay systems and two-player support.
projects.summary: Translates the 68000 game code to SH-4 for a native Dreamcast build; the project describes no emulation.

projects.title: Super Mario 64 Dreamcast Port
projects.status: Dreamcast build documented; README does not confirm physical-hardware testing.
projects.summary: Native Dreamcast port built from the Super Mario 64 decompilation, with a PowerVR renderer and VMU saves.

projects.title: Super Mario 64 PS3 Port
projects.status: PlayStation 3 port remains in development; package builds are documented but PKG testing is unverified.
projects.summary: Native PS3 port built from Super Mario 64 decompilation source using PSL1GHT.

projects.title: Super Mario 64 PS4 Port
projects.status: A PS4 package build is documented on an older branch; current playability and release status are unclear.
projects.summary: Native PS4 build target based on the Super Mario 64 decompilation.

projects.title: Super Mario 64 PS5 Port
projects.status: Version 1.0; console-tested title screen, file select, and castle grounds.
projects.summary: Native PS5 port based on the Ghostship project and Super Mario 64 decompilation.

projects.title: Super Mario 64 Vita Port
projects.status: Native Vita package built from the N64 decompilation; release age and current maintenance are limited.
projects.summary: Vita homebrew port built from Super Mario 64 decompilation source.

projects.title: Super Mario 64 Wii U Port
projects.status: Native Wii U build target is documented; the README does not establish gameplay completeness.
projects.summary: Wii U homebrew target for the Super Mario 64 decompilation-based port.

projects.title: Super Mario 64 DS 3DS Port
projects.status: WIP; README reports the full game playable on New 3DS at about 30 FPS. Older hardware is unverified.
projects.summary: Native port of the DS decompilation with a 3DS layer that implements required DS behavior.

projects.title: Super Mario Strikers Switch Port
projects.status: Version 1.3.0 Switch release; the README identifies this as a native source port, not a recompilation.
projects.summary: Nintendo Switch target for the Super Mario Strikers decompilation-based native port.

projects.title: Super Mario Strikers Vita Port
projects.status: Work in progress; a Vita backend boots, but rendering, audio, and stability work remains.
projects.summary: Vita target for a native port built on the Super Mario Strikers decompilation.

projects.title: Super Mario Sunshine PS5 Port
projects.status: Early version 0.10.0; console testing reached the opening, Delfino Plaza, and the first Bianco Hills episode.
projects.summary: Native PS5 port based on a PC port built from the Super Mario Sunshine decompilation; no emulator is used.

projects.title: Super Smash Bros. 3DS Port
projects.status: Native ARM11/PICA200 port; 60 FPS is not guaranteed and multiplayer is not supported.
projects.summary: 3DS implementation of Super Smash Bros. based on the original N64 game.

projects.title: Super Smash Bros. Melee 3DS Port
projects.status: Playable 1v1 is reported; heavy four-player scenes drop frames. Development is paused and compatibility is incomplete.
projects.summary: 3DS port based on Melee decompilation source.

projects.title: Super Smash Bros. Melee Original Xbox Port
projects.status: Maintainer reports a fully playable native Xbox build at 30–60 FPS; NTSC-U revision 1.02 is the tested version.
projects.summary: Original Xbox port based on the Melee decompilation; not GameCube emulation.

projects.title: Super Smash Bros. Melee Vita and PS5 Port
projects.status: Vita has releases; PS5 has experimental CI builds and hardware testing. Performance and completeness vary by platform.
projects.summary: Native ports of Melee decompilation source with replacement console services for Vita and PS5.

projects.title: A Link to the Past 3DS Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past
projects.status: Stable release with CIA and 3DSX packages.
projects.summary: Native 3DS port of the Zelda3 reverse-engineered engine.

projects.title: Link’s Awakening DX Multi-console Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Link’s Awakening DX
projects.platform: Game Boy Color → Dreamcast, Wii, Nintendo 3DS, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4
projects.status: Project reports PS3 gameplay in RPCS3 and title/gameplay on other targets; Dreamcast performance remains below full speed.
projects.summary: Static recompilation of Game Boy Color code to C with native platform backends. The repository documents several console targets and target-specific maturity limits.

projects.title: 2Ship2Harkinian 3DS Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Majora’s Mask
projects.status: Pre-alpha; project reports New 3DS boot, while normal-play crashes remain.
projects.summary: New Nintendo 3DS port of the 2Ship2Harkinian native engine.

projects.title: Majora’s Mask PS4 Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Majora’s Mask
projects.status: PS4 package release; maintainer reports an early PS4 Pro play test through the intro and Clock Town.
projects.summary: PlayStation 4 port of 2Ship2Harkinian using OpenOrbis and Piglet.

projects.title: 2Ship2Harkinian Wii U Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Majora’s Mask
projects.status: Native Wii U .rpx/.wuhb build is documented; there is no stable release.
projects.summary: Wii U port of the 2Ship2Harkinian native engine.

projects.title: Ocarina of Time Dreamcast Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
projects.status: Native Dreamcast build and CDI/VMU support are documented; the supported input is the GameCube European Master Quest debug build.
projects.summary: KallistiOS SH-4 port with a PowerVR display-list interpreter and AICA audio. README does not establish physical-hardware testing.

projects.title: Ship of Harkinian 3DS Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
projects.status: Alpha prerelease boots on hardware; compatibility and performance vary, and original 3DS support is unverified.
projects.summary: 3DS port derived from Ship of Harkinian, a native reimplementation built from Ocarina of Time decompilation work.

projects.title: Ocarina of Time 64 3DS Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
projects.status: Scene and game logic port; hardware playthrough remains in progress.
projects.summary: Native 3DS port built from Ocarina of Time decompilation code.

projects.title: Ocarina of Time PS4 Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
projects.status: PS4 package release; maintainer reports PS4 Pro tests with graphics, audio, controls, saves, mods, and 60 FPS interpolation.
projects.summary: PlayStation 4 port of Ship of Harkinian using OpenOrbis and Piglet.

projects.title: Ocarina of Time PS5 Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
projects.status: Version 1.2.0; maintainer reports PlayStation 5 firmware 9.00 testing and gameplay, with frame-rate samples rather than a full compatibility guarantee.
projects.summary: Native PS5 homebrew built on Ship of Harkinian; requires user-owned N64 game data.

projects.title: Ship of Harkinian Wii U Build
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
projects.status: Native Wii U .rpx/.wuhb build is documented; current stable release downloads target desktop.
projects.summary: Wii U build target for Ship of Harkinian, a native port using Ocarina of Time decompilation source.

projects.title: The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Ages Switch Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Ages
projects.status: Native Switch build based on the Oracle decompilation; requires the specified user-owned game image.
projects.summary: Nintendo Switch port for Oracle of Ages using native C code rather than Game Boy emulation.

projects.title: The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Seasons Switch Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Seasons
projects.status: Native Switch build based on the Oracle decompilation; requires the specified user-owned game image.
projects.summary: Nintendo Switch port for Oracle of Seasons using native C code rather than Game Boy emulation.

projects.title: The Minish Cap 3DS Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap
projects.status: Stable release series with USA/EU support; EU version is reported as most tested.
projects.summary: Native 3DS port based on Project Picori and The Minish Cap decompilation.

projects.title: The Minish Cap Decompilation and Native Ports
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap
projects.platform: Game Boy Advance → PC and Nintendo Switch homebrew
projects.status: Matching decompilation is in progress; the repository also contains work-in-progress native PC and Switch ports.
projects.summary: The project contains the Game Boy Advance decompilation and native port work for PC and Nintendo Switch. Its Switch build is experimental; consult the repository for supported game versions and build requirements.
projects.strategy: Matching decompilation with experimental native ports
projects.subtype: Decompilation and native platform port work

sources.label: Project README and platform build instructions

projects.title: The Wind Waker PS5 Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker
projects.status: Version 1.0.3; maintainer reports console testing through the Dragon Roost boss room.
projects.summary: Native PS5 port of the SwitchWaker decompilation-based project.

projects.title: Twilight Princess PS4 Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
projects.status: Release r25; native GoldHEN port supports documented GameCube and Wii disc IDs and targets up to 60 FPS.
projects.summary: PS4 port of the Dusklight reverse-engineered engine; does not use an emulator.

projects.title: Twilight Princess Switch Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
projects.status: Nintendo Switch NRO release; performance and compatibility vary by game build and device.
projects.summary: Native Switch port of the reverse-engineered Dusklight engine; no GameCube emulation layer is used.

projects.title: Twilight Princess PS5 Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
projects.status: Console testing reports boot and several minutes of play; save persistence works, while audio is not yet verified.
projects.summary: Native PS5 port of the reverse-engineered Dusklight engine; not a GameCube emulator.

projects.title: The Simpsons Game Switch Recompilation
projects.status: Early build with limited progress; requires the specified US retail XEX.
projects.summary: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 release for Switch with Vulkan/NVK.

projects.title: Tony Hawk’s Project 8 Switch Recompilation
projects.status: Early pipeline build; README notes missing objects and frame-rate dips. Requires retail game data.
projects.summary: Switch target for static recompilation of the Xbox 360 version.

projects.title: Tony Hawk’s Underground Vita Port
projects.status: Maintainer reports a playable Vita port with story and free skate; videos and online features are unavailable.
projects.summary: Native Vita port based on the PC project kisak-thug, using Xbox USA game data supplied by the user.

projects.title: Torchlight Switch Recompilation
projects.platform: Xbox 360 / Xbox Live Arcade → Nintendo Switch
projects.status: Static recompilation build; README reports variable frame rate by area and does not include game data.
projects.summary: Native Switch build of a statically recompiled Xbox release.

projects.title: Turok 3DS Port
projects.status: Early milestone; first level loads and can be explored, but the project is incomplete.
projects.summary: Nintendo 3DS port of the original Turok engine source, not a decompilation.
